products.name: Butter Garlic Jumbo Prawns (Cleaned & Deveined)
products.description: Large sea prawns peeled and completely deveined with tail-on. Crisp sweet bite, fresh from daily trawlers.

products.name: Crispy Amritsari Fish Tikka (Ready to Cook)
products.description: Fresh boneless fish cubes marinated in crushed ajwain, roasted besan, mustard oil, and Punjabi spices. Pan-sear or air-fry in 8 minutes.

products.name: Mangalore Surmai Tawa Fry (Large Steaks)
products.description: Center-cut neat steaks from daily fresh catches off the Mangalore-Malabar coast. Shucked, scale-scraped, cleaned in RO water, and immediately blast-chilled to 0°C - 2°C.

products.name: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh (Curry & Biryani Cut)
products.description: Young pasture-grazed tender goat (under 9 months). Balanced mix of succulent bone-in shoulder, ribs, and marrow pieces. Bone-dust washed in chilled water.

products.name: Andhra Nati Koli Pepper Roast (Country Chicken Cut)
products.description: Free-range desi country chicken with firm meat and rich yellow skin fat. Skin-on, thoroughly singed and cleaned for authentic village broth flavor.

products.name: Crispy Rechado White Pomfret (Whole Cleaned)
products.description: Whole cleaned pristine silver-scaled pomfret. Degilled, gutted and scored with neat diamond slits on both sides. Ideal for tawa fry or rechado masala.

products.name: Grand Coastal Feast Box (Surmai + Prawns + Mutton)
products.description: The ultimate Sunday banquet pack: 500g Seer Fish Steaks + 350g Sea Tiger Prawns + 500g Tender Goat Biryani Cut. Delivered inside an extra-capacity reusable cold box.

products.name: Golden Herb Butter Chicken Breast (Boneless Fillets)
products.description: Tender boneless chicken breast fillets trimmed of all excess fat. Bio-secured farm chicken, 100% antibiotic residue-free.
